findings.message: Configuration directory ownership and mode prevent daemon service startup. Directory changed from 584792:584792 mode 0750 to 0:0 mode 0700. Service runs as _daemon_ (UID 584792) but has no read/execute permission on /opt/demo. Service must open /opt/demo/server.conf before listening with no fallback. Restore daemon ownership and 0750 mode, or provide explicit confirmation that this breaking change is intentional.

summary: Source commit bumped 0000...0010 → 0000...0011. Recipe runtime-config part's override-build script changed: /opt/demo directory permission 0750 → 0700, ownership 584792:584792 → 0:0 (root). Service runs as daemon UID 584792; no fallback provided for config file access.
